title: Local Consistency and Higher-Order Structure of Spherical Interpolation
summary: Spherical Interpolation of orDER $n$ (SIDER-$n$) is a recursive high-order interpolation construction for data on the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^2$, built from repeated spherical linear interpolation (SLERP). This paper gives a local consistency analysis of SIDER for smooth spherical curves sampled at equally spaced parameter values. The analysis is carried out in geodesic normal coordinates, which allows the SIDER recursion to be compared with classical Neville interpolation while retaining the curvature-dependent corrections introduced by SLERP.
